units.source_text: 玉鬘于八月中除丧服。

en.t: Tamakazura took off her mourning clothes in the middle of the eighth month.

units.source_text: 源氏以为九月乃不吉之月，故决定延至十月入宫。

en.t: Genji considered the ninth month unlucky, so he decided to postpone her entry into the palace until the tenth month.

units.source_text: 皇上等得很心焦。

en.t: The Emperor grew very impatient as he waited.

units.source_text: 恋慕玉鬘的人闻此消息，都很惋惜，各自去找替自己帮忙的侍女，向她们恳求，希望在入宫之前玉成其事。

en.t: The men who loved Tamakazura were all distressed when they heard the news, and each went to the lady-in-waiting who had been helping him, begging her to bring matters to a happy conclusion before Tamakazura entered the palace.

units.source_text: 然而此事比只手塞住吉野大瀑布更难，侍女的回答都是“毫无办法！”

en.t: Yet this was harder than stopping the great Yoshino waterfall with one hand, and the ladies-in-waiting all answered, There is absolutely nothing to be done.

units.source_text: 夕雾那天冒昧地对玉鬘说了那些话，不知玉鬘对他作何感想，心中甚感痛苦。

en.t: Yugiri was deeply troubled, not knowing what Tamakazura thought of him after the presumptuous things he had said to her that day.

units.source_text: 此时他就起劲地东奔西走，装作热心帮忙的样子，希图博得玉鬘的欢心。

en.t: At this point he bustled about energetically, pretending to be eager to help, hoping to win Tamakazura's favor.

units.source_text: 此后他不再轻率求爱，只管努力镇静，不露声色。

en.t: After that he no longer made rash advances, but simply tried hard to remain calm and reveal nothing.

units.source_text: 玉鬘的几个亲兄弟，一时尚未熟悉，还不曾来访，都在焦灼地等候她入宫之期，准备前来帮忙。

en.t: Tamakazura's several real brothers, still not yet familiar with her and not having visited, waited anxiously for the day she would enter the palace, ready to come and help.

units.source_text: 柏木中将以前向她求爱，费尽心血；现在则音信全无。

en.t: Captain Kashiwagi had once poured all his effort into courting her, but now there was no word from him at all.

units.source_text: 玉鬘的侍女们都笑他老实。

en.t: Tamakazura's ladies-in-waiting all laughed at him for being so honest and proper.

units.source_text: 有一天，他忽然以父亲的使者身份来访。

en.t: One day, he suddenly came to visit as his father's messenger.

units.source_text: 由于向来习惯了偷偷摸摸地送情书，所以今天还是不敢堂皇出面，却于月明之夜，走进来躲在桂树底下了。

en.t: Because he had long been used to secretly sending love letters, even today he did not dare appear openly, but slipped in on the moonlit night and hid beneath a katsura tree.

units.source_text: 玉鬘向来不接见他，侍女们也大都不肯替他传达。

en.t: Tamakazura had never received him, and most of her ladies-in-waiting had refused to convey his messages.

units.source_text: 今天则藩篱尽撤，在南面安排了客座招待他。

en.t: Today, however, all barriers were removed, and a guest seat was prepared for him on the southern side.

units.source_text: 至于亲口答话，玉鬘还怕难为情，所以叫侍女宰相君传言。

en.t: As for answering him in person, Tamakazura still felt too embarrassed, so she had the lady-in-waiting Saisho no Kimi speak for her.

units.source_text: 柏木心中不快，开口说道：“父亲特地派我前来，是为了有些话不便叫人传言。

en.t: Kashiwagi was displeased and began, My father specially sent me here because some matters are not suitable to entrust to another person's words.

units.source_text: 如今你如此疏远我，叫我怎能把这些话告诉你呢？

en.t: Now that you keep me at such a distance, how can I tell you these things?

units.source_text: 自古道：‘手足之情割不断。’看似老生常谈，确是真情实理啊！”

en.t: Since ancient times people have said, The bond between siblings cannot be cut. It may sound like a commonplace saying, but it is truly sincere and reasonable.

units.source_text: 玉鬘答道：“我也想把多年来积集胸中的话向阿哥诉说。

en.t: Tamakazura replied, I too would like to tell my elder brother the things that have gathered in my heart over many years.

units.source_text: 只因近日心情异常恶劣，竟至不能起身。

en.t: It is only that lately I have been feeling so terribly unwell that I cannot even rise.

units.source_text: 阿哥如此见怪，使我觉得反而疏远了。”说时态度非常认真。

en.t: When you blame me in this way, elder brother, it makes me feel all the more distant. As she said this, her manner was very earnest.

units.source_text: 柏木说：“你心情恶劣，不能起身，可否容许我到你床前的帷屏外面来呢？

en.t: Kashiwagi said, If you are unwell and cannot rise, might you allow me to come as far as the outside of the curtains by your bed?

units.source_text: ……罢了罢了，我这要求也太不体谅人了。”便悄悄地传达了内大臣的话，其神情也很雅观，并不逊于他人。

en.t: No, no, this request of mine is far too inconsiderate. Then he quietly conveyed the Minister of the Interior's message, and his bearing was elegant, no less refined than anyone else's.

units.source_text: 内大臣的话是：“有关入宫之种种情况，我无由详细闻知，甚望一一秘密告我。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior's message was, I have no way to learn the details of the various arrangements for your palace entry, and I very much hope you will secretly tell me each of them.

units.source_text: 我因凡事防人耳目，未能亲自前来，而又未便通问，为此不胜挂念。”

en.t: Because I must avoid people's eyes in everything, I cannot come in person, and it is also inconvenient to send inquiries, so I am deeply worried.

units.source_text: 柏木又乘便把他自己的话叫宰相君转达：“自今以后，我不会再写那种愚蠢的信来了。

en.t: Kashiwagi also took the opportunity to have Saisho no Kimi convey his own words: From now on, I will no longer send those foolish letters.

units.source_text: 不过，不论关系如何，对我那种热情熟视无睹，终叫我越想越恨。

en.t: Even so, whatever our relationship may be, the way you ignored my devotion makes me feel more resentful the more I think about it.

units.source_text: 首先恨的是今夜对我的招待：应该在北面接见我。

en.t: What I resent first is tonight's reception: you should have received me on the northern side.

units.source_text: 如果像你这等高级侍女不屑招待我，叫几个下级侍女引导我也无不可。

en.t: If a high-ranking lady-in-waiting like you disdained to receive me, it would have been acceptable to have a few lower-ranking attendants guide me.

units.source_text: 像今天这样的冷遇，实在无有其例。

en.t: Such cold treatment as today's is truly without precedent.

units.source_text: 我逢到了种种少有的遭遇！”他侧着头，恨个不休，样子有些可笑。

en.t: I have met with all sorts of rare experiences. He tilted his head and went on complaining, looking somewhat comical.

units.source_text: 宰相君便把他的话传告玉鬘。

en.t: Saisho no Kimi then relayed his words to Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 玉鬘说：“突然亲近，深恐别人取笑。

en.t: Tamakazura said, If I suddenly became intimate with him, I would be deeply afraid that others would laugh.

units.source_text: 因此长年沦落之苦况，亦未曾向阿哥罄诉，反比以前更多苦恨了。”

en.t: For that reason, I have not been able to tell my elder brother fully of the hardships of my long years of wandering, and my bitterness has grown even greater than before.

units.source_text: 这只是应酬之辞。

en.t: These were only polite words of reply.

units.source_text: 柏木觉得不好意思，闭口不作一声。

en.t: Kashiwagi felt embarrassed and shut his mouth without saying a word.

units.source_text: 后来赠诗云：

en.t: Later, the poem he sent read as follows:
